title: Define complex represented-matrix norm contracts
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed public-contract task only; it does not select a complex quantity representation or activate implementation.
objective: Define and verify explicit unit-aware contracts for dense and, when justified by an actual consumer, sparse complex represented-matrix norms used by defect, spin-space, and Stage C calculations.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, establish exact complex scalar storage, immutability, unit, shape, finiteness, conversion, and norm-result contracts.
Use actual defect, spin-space, or Stage C consumers to justify each abstraction and preserve Hermitian versus general-complex distinctions.
Create a human checkpoint only if materially different defensible public representations remain after applying existing quantity and operator authority.
completion_criteria: One explicit complex represented-matrix norm contract is documented, typed, tested, and human-accepted where required.
At least one actual complex consumer is migrated without changing retained numerical evidence.
Real and complex behavior, units, storage, overflow policy, and dense or sparse boundaries are mutually consistent.
exclusions: Do not create speculative complex sparse storage, generalized eigensolvers, or a project-owned unit algebra without demonstrated need.
Do not conflate a matrix norm with physical alignment, scientific validation, or uncertainty quantification.
No protected execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
